design.primary_unit: paired model-seed macro client NLL difference; 3 per task/alpha
design.delta_convention: prior minus zero; negative is beneficial
design.gain_convention: zero minus prior; positive is beneficial
design.data_scope: official TRAIN for model training and local fitting; disjoint TRAIN-derived development holdouts for scoring; no official TEST
design.hypothesis: Greater heterogeneity produces greater gain is a prespecified hypothesis, never an assumed conclusion.
design.decision_rule: Descriptive mean ordering G(alpha=.1)>G(.5)>G(1) assessed separately on both tasks; all raw seed/client outcomes retained, no tuning to force ordering.

cifar.interpretation: Mean gain ordering matches the prespecified hypothesis in this fixed partition family.
cifar.uncertainty: Only one partition realization per alpha; three model seeds share each partition. Alpha also changes client sizes, memberships and learned model quality. This is descriptive evidence, not a general or causal heterogeneity law.

fashion.interpretation: Mean gain ordering matches the prespecified hypothesis in this fixed partition family.
fashion.uncertainty: Only one partition realization per alpha; three model seeds share each partition. Alpha also changes client sizes, memberships and learned model quality. This is descriptive evidence, not a general or causal heterogeneity law.

overall_interpretation: Prespecified mean ordering observed on both tasks within this design; replication across partitions remains required for a general claim.
